themes.title: Trump‑Russia Diesel Deal Fallout
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's agreement to import Russian diesel to lower US domestic fuel prices has triggered severe international and domestic backlash. The agreement has drawn sharp condemnation from Ukrainian leadership and European allies while provoking bipartisan criticism in Washington over financial lifelines to Moscow.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Bipartisan senators and Ukrainian officials condemn Trump's deal to import Russian energy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French conservative media reports extensively on Ukrainian fury and transatlantic discord over the bilateral energy deal.

themes.title: Scandinavian Far‑Right Youth Surge
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties in Scandinavia continue to demonstrate strong political momentum, driven by surging popularity among young voters. Norway's Progress Party (FrP) has posted record polling figures among youth, while political friction around populist influence persists in neighboring Sweden.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP hits historic poll highs, becoming Norway's largest party overall and capturing 53% support among under-30 voters.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats remain a primary focal point of institutional and civic friction regarding right-wing political influence.

themes.title: US Sanctions and Pressure on International Institutions
themes.blurb: The US administration's hostile posture toward multilateral institutions, including sanctions targeting the International Criminal Court (ICC) and sharp attacks on global prize committees, resonates across international right-wing coverage. The policy reflects a broader nationalist strategy to challenge international judicial oversight.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration sanctions ICC officials and issues ultimatums to crippling effect following warrants for allied leaders.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French outlets track Washington's sanctions and demands directed at ICC member states.

themes.title: Populist Leaders Clash with Mainstream Media Outlets
themes.blurb: Conservative and populist figures across multiple nations are intensifying confrontations with mainstream news media. Actions range from DOJ antitrust investigations into US news pools following press access bans to legal defamation battles in France and public attacks on media sensationalism in Norway.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Justice Department investigates major TV networks for potential antitrust violations after they suspended pool coverage in solidarity with barred outlets.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella files legal actions against investigative news outlet Mediapart over reports on historical antisemitic posts.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP leader Sylvi Listhaug publicly attacks press outlets for using sensationalist language to undermine conservative discourse.
